top_choice_rationale: The Holst-Mojsov-Drucker proposal recognizes a mature, coherent physiological discovery with a well-defined mechanism and sustained, broad therapeutic consequences in diabetes and obesity. Limiting the citation to GLP-1 physiology and the therapeutic principle it enabled makes this three-person attribution more defensible than a claim to the entire later drug-development pathway.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific connection is apparent from the supplied profile. My documented spatial-transcriptomics coauthorship concerns other researchers and does not identify a connection to the proposed laureates.
